name: CLEATUS
description: CLEATUS is the AI-native platform for government contractors. The CLEATUS connector turns Claude into a GovCon teammate with live access to your workspace: search federal, SLED, and Canadian opportunities plus pre-RFP forecasts across 40,000+ sources, manage your pipeline and pursuits, create and assign tasks, run saved searches, and draft and execute Workflows.

_published_faq.name: How do I add CLEATUS to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add CLEATUS to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.cleat.ai/api/mcp/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the CLEATUS MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: CLEATUS lists 36 MCP tools, including cleatus_activate_workflow, cleatus_add_to_pipeline, cleatus_create_folder, cleatus_create_saved_search, cleatus_create_task, cleatus_create_workflow, cleatus_delete_document, cleatus_delete_saved_search, cleatus_delete_task, cleatus_delete_workflow, cleatus_dismiss_recommendation, and cleatus_documentation.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to CLEATUS?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to CLEATUS in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
CLEATUS requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
CLEATUS is developed by CLEATUS. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
